title: robotindex Builds & Mods Entry
description: One entry in data/builds-mods.json — the single canonical source for every firmware/config/open-source project the site lists. This replaces the three separate hardcoded arrays (OPEN_SOURCE, CONFIGS, FIRMWARE) that used to live only inside builds-mods.html, plus the name/desc text that was separately re-typed onto each linking product page. Live GitHub stats (stars, license, last update, open issues) are NOT part of this file — those are still fetched at request time by netlify/functions/gh-meta.js and cached at the CDN, exactly as today. This file only holds the editorial facts a human decided: what it's called, what it does, which of the three tabs it belongs in, and where the repo is.

id.description: Stable unique id. Product records reference an entry by this id (firmwareCommunity[].buildsModsId), so it must never be renamed once a product links to it. Two catalog entries can point at the same repo (e.g. Petoi Bittle X and Petoi Quaddle both cite PetoiCamp/OpenCat) — they still get distinct ids, since they're distinct editorial entries, not distinct repos.

tab.description: Which Builds & Mods tab this renders under. 'opensource' is gated by the site's Strict Open Source policy (public repo, OSI/hardware license); 'configs' and 'firmware' are not license-gated the same way.

repo.description: Canonical source URL. Usually a GitHub repo, but not always (a few entries point at a docs site or project homepage instead, e.g. Elephant Robotics, Annin Robotics, Valetudo, OpenMower, AiboHack) — gh-meta.js only fetches live stats for github.com URLs and silently skips the rest, which is expected.
